newsitem.title: USA: CBOT raises March corn futures margins.
newsitem.headline: CBOT raises March corn futures margins.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade said it raised the initial minimum margin requirements for trading March corn futures to $1,755 a contract from $810.
Minimum maintenance and hedge margins were also raised, to $1,300 a contract from $600.
The changes became effective with the start of overnight trading on Project A, the exchange said.
The changes come ahead of the expiration of March grain contracts at midday on Wednesday.
